producers.label: College football (ESPN)

producers.label: College football play-by-play (CollegeFootballData)
producers.schedule: Sat/Sun/Mon, Sep-Dec; monthly Jan-Aug (the legacy espn_cfb box-score stages are switched off)

producers.label: College football (stats.ncaa.org)
producers.schedule: Dispatched by ncaa-mfb-football-raw after each scrape, late Aug-late Jan

producers.label: NFL (ESPN)
producers.schedule: Weekly (Tue) Sep-Feb; rosters Mon; models Mar 1 (the season window closes after the conference-championship upload, so the two-week wait for the Super Bowl reads idle, not stale)
